hypothesis: Can one synthesis call recover a complete answer when retrieval is split into small searches, but understanding receives the original question and the whole deduplicated evidence shelf?
boundary: Development A/B test on the same five hard questions. It reuses frozen Gate 16D.7 retrieval and does not rerun or improve search.

conditions.retrieved_shelf: Deduplicated messages actually selected by Gate 16D.7.
conditions.oracle_shelf: Deduplicated accepted messages locked before Gate 16D.7.

synthesis_input: All deduplicated messages on the selected shelf
synthesis_output: One natural complete answer using only shelf evidence. No per-fact extractor and no code concatenation.
